provenance.source_title: POV You're Every Rank In The CJNG

examples.psychological_goal: 用贫困算术让堕落的第一步显得自动发生
examples.expression_mechanism: 被动化选择 + 价码落地
examples.example_text: Nobody told you to quit school, but the choice made itself. 200 pesos a day to stand on the corner of Guadalajara with a phone.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"没人叫你X，但选择自己发生了"开脱式句式，立刻接上具体价码

examples.psychological_goal: 展示主角的专业直觉：危险信号识别已是肌肉记忆
examples.expression_mechanism: 异常细节递进 + 本能反应
examples.example_text: A truck circles the block twice. Same truck, different driver the second time. Your thumb is already typing.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"同X不同Y"的细节对照展示专业警觉，并以一个下意识动作收尾
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制放哨的具体暗号

examples.psychological_goal: 把代价与收益塞进同一个画面，道德妥协完成第一次自我说服
examples.example_text: You didn't know the answers. You stopped going to class three months ago, but he's wearing the shoes he wanted.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"你失去了A，但B得到了C"的并置句让合理化显得既可怜又成立
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制弟弟与鞋的设定

examples.psychological_goal: 用三个短句把高危行为定性为日常
examples.expression_mechanism: 日常化三连（星期/年龄/次数）
examples.example_text: Now it's Tuesday. You're 17. You've made this run 40 times.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"现在是周二。你X岁。这事你做过N次。"的节拍宣告风险已例行化

examples.psychological_goal: 逃生的建议被一个触摸信封的小动作否决
examples.expression_mechanism: 忠告 + 身体动作代替回答
examples.example_text: He said stop while you can. You think about that sometimes, but then you touch the envelope in your pocket and keep driving.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"你想起了忠告，然后一个动作驳回它"的结构写选择的不可逆
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制信封与监狱的设定

examples.psychological_goal: 用对称句式把杀人流程写成岗位定义
examples.expression_mechanism: 冷酷对仗（问题是人，方案是暴力）
examples.example_text: The problems are people and the solution is violence.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"The problems are X and the solution is Y"把道德重量压进工作描述

examples.psychological_goal: 麻木被认证为专业能力，人格解体完成
examples.expression_mechanism: 无感陈述 + 反转式自我评价
examples.example_text: You feel nothing at this photo. That's how you know you're good at this.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"你毫无感觉——这就是你擅长此事的证明"把缺陷写成资质
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制 photo 的具体情境

examples.psychological_goal: 展示恐惧的自维持机制：暴力无需使用就已生效
examples.expression_mechanism: 克制执法 + 系统判词
examples.example_text: They just stand there until he finds the money. He finds it and that's how the system works. Fear maintains itself.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"他们只是站着，直到X发生"的克制场景引出"恐惧自我维持"的判词
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制保护费的具体设定

examples.psychological_goal: 用跨辖区数字展示金融结构的防御纵深
examples.expression_mechanism: 复杂度量化（N国搜查令/一笔交易）
examples.example_text: You built a structure so complex that investigators need warrants in six countries to follow one transaction.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"需要N个司法辖区才能追踪一次X"的对比量化结构复杂度
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制国别与结构细节

examples.psychological_goal: 七个词给身份升维：从违法者到系统本身
examples.example_text: You're not a criminal, you're infrastructure.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"你不是X，你是Y"给角色身份升维，Y要比X更大更冷
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制 infrastructure 的用法

examples.psychological_goal: 一句话给高层召见定下生死二义性
examples.expression_mechanism: 层级规则判词（X or a bullet）
examples.example_text: Meetings at that level mean promotion or a bullet.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"那个层级的X意味着晋升或子弹"把职场逻辑翻译成生死逻辑
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该表述的语境

examples.psychological_goal: 把爬升逻辑推到极致：每一级都可能是最后一级
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定定性 + 双结局排比
examples.example_text: This isn't a promotion, it's a test. Pass and you move up. Fail and you disappear.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"这不是A，是测试。过了X，输了Y"的对称句给考验定价
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制 move up/disappear 的配对

examples.psychological_goal: 真名揭示：八级职级瞬间重写为一个人的一生
examples.expression_mechanism: 真名宣告 + 起源对照
examples.example_text: You're Nemesio Oseguera Cervantes. And you built this empire from dirt.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在顶端用"你是[真名]。你从泥土里建起这一切"完成身份翻转
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制真实姓名与生平

examples.psychological_goal: 家族代价与帝国规模同框结算
examples.example_text: Your family dismantled piece by piece. You built an empire that made governments afraid.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"你的X被一寸寸拆解。你建起了让Y恐惧的Z"把账单与成就压在同一句里
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制家族与帝国的具体内容

examples.psychological_goal: 用帝国终局定律收束，把"今天"变成刑期
examples.expression_mechanism: 普遍定律 + 时态翻转
examples.example_text: And every empire ends the same way. You were untouchable until today.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"所有X都以同样方式终结。你直到今天都不可触碰"给传奇落锁
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制 empire/untouchable 的措辞

warnings: no_humor_in_source: 源片为零幽默黑色冷叙述， humor 类型无可选样本
